csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-src 'none'; media-src 'none'; object-src 'self'
scope: Synthetic isolated MV3 pilot only. Sidepanel document at 375x820, not browser-native side-panel chrome. Same production script restrictions; tighter network/frame/style policy. No production wallet, encrypted storage, WebAuthn, hardware, chain, widget implementation or signing proof.
checks: Two separately built UI documents hydrate from the real MV3 worker
Router guard rejects protected deep link while locked
Background unlock broadcasts into both reactive app snapshots
Each app renders all three precompiled locales and literal @ under CSP
Invalid asynchronous validation dispatches zero approvals
Pending submission is disabled and accepted exactly once after validation/authorization
Cancel and edits invalidate pending validation and authorization
Wallet/network replacement during validation and authorization dispatches nothing; fresh approval is required
KeepAlive preserves input across actual navigation, pauses timer, and cancels pending work
Vuetify dialog opens and closes in both apps
Native custom element receives attributes/signer property and emits token-change
Lock during validation and authorization dispatches nothing and evicts protected routes in both apps
Normal journeys produce no CSP violations or page errors under the production script restriction
Full browser/worker restart hydrates persisted state without fixture overrides
